# Output from multiqc 

https://xsun1229.github.io/camseq-m6a/multiqc_report_genome_all_round4.html

# Motif counting

## read depth 10, p-value < 0.001, methylation level > 0.05

```{r , fig.height=5, fig.width=10}

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

file <- "/project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/pipeline030926/workspace_round4/report_sites/filtered/genome.tsv.gz"

df <- fread(file)
df_filtered <- df[df$Ratio_sample01 > 0.05 & df$pval_sample01 < 0.001,]

df_filtered[, motif_3mer := substr(motif, 2, 4)]

rev_comp <- function(x) {
  chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", paste(rev(strsplit(x, "")[[1]]), collapse = ""))
}

convert_motif <- function(m) {
  if (substr(m, 2, 2) == "T") {
    return(rev_comp(m))
  } else {
    return(m)
  }
}

df_filtered[, motif_3mer_norm := sapply(motif_3mer, convert_motif)]

dt_plot <- df_filtered[, .(
  percentage = sum(Uncon_sample01) / sum(Depth_sample01) * 100
), by = motif_3mer_norm]

dt_plot[, sample_label := paste0("sample01\n",nrow(df_filtered),"sites")]

ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = percentage, y = sample_label)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = motif_3mer_norm),
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.15),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = motif_3mer_norm, color = motif_3mer_norm),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.15),
    vjust = -0.7,
    size = 4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "read depth = 10, binomial p-value < 0.001",
    x = "Percentage (%)",
    y = "Sample \nTotal site passing filter"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



```
